sections.heading: Frequently asked Questions
sections.text: Frequently asked Questions Why should I buy waterproof mattress protectors? It's recommended to have a waterproof mattress protector as it sheilds your mattress from unexpected spills, stains, bed wetting and moisture. Why should I buy mattress protectors online? The benefits of buying mattress protectors online include doorstep delivery and it will keep your mattress protected for long. What is the best mattress protector material? Due to cotton's durability and breathability, it is the preferred material for mattress protectors. Which brand mattress protector is best? Many brands offer mattress protectors but it is recommneded to go for a trusted one. Duro Safe Mattress Protector powered by Swiss HeiQ Viroblock is India's first antiviral mattress protector and gives additional protection from harmful bacteria and virus. Do you put a fitted sheet over a mattress protector? Yes, putting a fitted sheet over a mattress protector is highly recommended as a mattress protector is not a replacement for bedsheet. How much should you spend on a mattress protector? Nowadays there are many mattress protectors available but a good one will starts from Rs.1200, depending on the material and features. How often should you wash a mattress protector? You should wash your mattress protector once every month. How do I choose a mattress protector? Make sure to research about the fabric and features of the mattress protector. Cotton is a good choice and extra features like antimicrobial protection and colour options are also great plus.
